name: onepassword
title: 1Password
description: Your 1Password items from the keyboard, through the op command line tool. Enter copies the password; the username, the one-time code and the item in the app are one key away.
author: pal

settings.label: Account
settings.description: Passed as --account to every op call: a shorthand, sign-in address, account id or user id. Empty uses the CLI's default.

settings.label: Vaults
settings.description: Only these vaults are listed, and each becomes a filter in the palette. Empty lists every vault. A change takes effect when the extension host restarts.

settings.label: Refresh after
settings.description: Seconds the item list is kept before op is asked again. Refresh in the panel asks at once.

store.tagline: Copy a 1Password password, username or one-time code
features: Every item you can see, favourites first, with the vault, the username and the website
`enter` copies the password, `cmd+u` the username, `cmd+t` the current one-time code
`cmd+o` opens the item in the 1Password app
Search by website, username, category, vault or tag, so `github.com` finds the login
Secrets are fetched only when you copy one and never kept in the list, the index or a log
Signed out, or without the op tool, one row says how to sign in or where to get it

screenshots.caption: Items with their vault, username and website, favourites first
The detail pane (cmd+I): vault, category, username, website, tags and when it was last updated
Copy the password, the username or the one-time code, or open the app
The vault dropdown (Tab) narrows the list to one of the vaults in the settings: Work

actions.title: Copy password
actions.description: `op item get --fields label=password --reveal`; "Copied password" in the HUD.

items.title: 1Password
items.description: Every item you can see, favourites first.
